en.askTitle: Tell it your Mac, clip length and rules, and get a tested, licence-checked shortlist of offline music generators
en.runTitle: A YouTube explainer maker on a 16 GB Apple-silicon Mac: which free offline music generators are safe for monetised videos

fields.label: Computer and available memory
fields.value: Apple-silicon Mac with 16 GB RAM shared with other work

fields.label: Commercial or noncommercial use
fields.value: Commercial: background music for monetised YouTube explainers

fields.label: Account and network rules
fields.value: Nothing uploaded, no subscription, no accounts or saved logins; gated models skipped

fields.label: Narration and style needs
fields.value: Background music under narration in short explainers

en.template: Compare local instrumental music options for {machine}, {duration}, {use} and {rules}. Separate code and weight licences, document exact revisions, plan memory-stop checks and distinguish completed results from exclusions. Use {style} to design a listening checklist. Ask before downloading models, accepting terms, uploading audio or spending money.

phases.title: Check the Mac and the public licences, then pick four models that could run
phases.note: Model cards, code licences and model-weight licences read from the original sources
phases.judgment: It kept the code licence and the model licence apart. MusicGen and AudioLDM have permissive code but non-commercial model weights, and a missing licence file was treated as a warning sign, not as permission.

phases.title: Install each model in isolation and run the same five prompts under a 6 GB memory guard
phases.note: One model at a time, with memory checked while it ran
phases.judgment: It reported that only two of the four models finished, not four. One was stopped for memory after briefly reaching 6.54 GB, and one was skipped because it needs a login, which the rules forbid.

phases.title: Measure the clips, recompute the numbers a second time, and assemble the report
phases.note: Loudness, clipping, silence and an automated text-match score, labelled as such
phases.judgment: The measurements were checked a second time: file metrics for all ten clips were recomputed again, and the repeated text-match scores came out exactly the same.

workers: Read the public model cards, licence texts and install notes for each candidate, keeping code licences and model-weight licences separate

chipNames.https://huggingface.co/stabilityai/stabl: Stable Audio Open Small: model card

zh.askTitle: 告诉它你的 Mac、片段时长和使用规则，就能得到一份实测并核对过授权的离线音乐生成短名单
zh.runTitle: 一位 YouTube 讲解视频创作者、一台 16 GB 内存的苹果芯片 Mac：哪些免费离线音乐生成工具可用于盈利视频

fields.label: 电脑和可用内存
fields.value: 苹果芯片 Mac，16 GB 内存，还要和其他工作共用

fields.label: 商业或非商业用途
fields.value: 商业用途：盈利 YouTube 讲解视频的背景音乐

fields.label: 账号和网络规则
fields.value: 不上传任何内容、不订阅付费、不注册账号、不用已保存的登录；需要登录的模型跳过

fields.label: 旁白与风格需要
fields.value: 短讲解视频里旁白下方的背景音乐

zh.template: 为 {machine}、{duration}、{use} 以及 {rules} 比较本地纯器乐选项。分开核对代码与权重许可，记录具体版本，规划内存停止检查，并区分已完成结果和排除项。根据 {style} 制定试听清单。下载模型、接受条款、上传音频或花钱前先征求我的同意。

phases.title: 查看这台 Mac 和公开授权，再选出四个有可能跑得动的模型
phases.note: 从原始来源阅读模型说明、代码授权和模型权重授权
phases.judgment: 它把代码授权和模型授权分开看。MusicGen 和 AudioLDM 的代码授权宽松，但模型权重是非商业的；找不到授权文件也被当作警示信号，而不是默认允许。

phases.title: 逐个隔离安装模型，在 6 GB 内存保护下用同样的五条提示词运行
phases.note: 一次只跑一个模型，运行时持续检查内存
phases.judgment: 它如实报告四个模型里只有两个跑完，而不是四个。一个在内存短暂冲到 6.54 GB 后被停掉，另一个因为需要登录而跳过，这是规则不允许的。

phases.title: 测量音频片段，再重算一遍数字，并整理成报告
phases.note: 响度、削波、静音占比，以及标明为自动参考的文本匹配分数
phases.judgment: 测量结果被第二次核对：十段音频的文件指标都重新计算过，重复运行的文本匹配分数也完全一致。

workers: 阅读每个候选模型的公开说明、授权文本和安装说明，把代码授权和模型权重授权分开记录
